title: Multiplayer is live early
body: Set your Call of Duty account address to New Zealand and Multiplayer opens now on every platform.

title: Modern Warfare 4 launches
body: Full release at midnight local time with 33 weapons, 33 Operators, Multiplayer and DMZ.

title: Shipment arrives
body: The fan-favorite map joins the Core 6v6 rotation a few days after launch.

title: Possession and Infected
body: Two Halloween modes land the week after launch. Infected follows on Oct 30.

title: Launch patch notes
body: UAV health up to 150, Flash and Concussion toned down, Battle Hardened and Resupply buffed.

title: DMZ early access is live
body: Digital pre-orders of the Standard or Vault Edition can play all of DMZ now, three days before launch.

title: Full launch arsenal revealed
body: Every weapon, Apex Attachment, perk, killstreak and piece of equipment, with Player Level unlocks from 1 to 55.

title: Campaign early access is live
body: Finishing campaign missions unlocks eight Operators for Multiplayer and DMZ.

title: Warzone integration
body: MW4 weapons and content come to Call of Duty: Warzone in Season 1, later this year.

title: C.O.D.E. Valor Pack
body: A pack supporting veterans, made with Medal of Honor recipient Kyle Carpenter. It unlocks the Kyle Operator.
